To the west, the location of the improvement is fixed by the recently constructed interchange between Lincoln Highway and Interstate Highway 57 and the presently improved intersection at Lincoln Highway and Cicero Avenue.
These considerations and the extensive residential and commercial developments, long established in the area through which this improvement will pass, have limited the location of this improvement to the existing corridor. The study considered how best to accommodate the highway improvement largely within the existing right-of-way with as little land taking and disruption to business and neighborhood values as possible while improving alignment, increasing safety and adding the traffic capacity required for the design year 1990.
Alternate alignments (designated "A" and "B") considered for this improvement were located to make optimum use of the existing right-of-way. A four-lane facility is proposed for that portion east of Western Avenue and a six-lane facility for that portion west of Western Avenue. Additional turning lanes are provided at intersections, as required. Generally, the centerline of the improved highway is located on the centerline of the present and proposed right-of-way, thus equalizing to a great extent the taking of private property north and south of the improvement. However, in two locations existing features required other alignments. Existing topographic features and facilities were disturbed as little as possible. In the built-up portions of the corridor, the absence of an adequate right-of-way width requires land takings involving both business and residential property.
Descriptions of the two alternate alignments developed during the course of the study are given below.
1. Alignment "A"
Alignment "A" locates the road improvement in the middle of the right-of-way, holding the centerline along the east-west section lines throughout the length of the improvement, except in the vicinity of Crawford Avenue where slight shifts are made.
From Cicero Avenue, the western terminus of the proposed project, eastward to Kostner Avenue the proposed improvement follows the existing centerline of Lincoln Highway. Minor land taking only
